ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% high-intensity white to 40% low-intensity black/gray pixels across the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Primary contiguous high-intensity white field from the distal tip to the midline, bisected by thin vertical low-intensity striations. Right lobe: Predominantly low-intensity black field with a dense mosaic of high-intensity white mottling and a large irregular white cluster in the medial region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) concentrated on the distal third of the left lobe's trailing edge. Moderate-frequency, lower-amplitude variations along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe exhibits a convex outer boundary tapering to a sharp distal tip. The right lobe exhibits a corresponding convex sweep, though the lower proximal edge is occluded by water.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters detected at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with localized scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of unaligned, multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) traversing the black regions of the right lobe and overlapping the white fields of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) throughout both lobes; distinctive hook-shaped white marking in the lower-central quadrant of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme jaggedness of the distal tip of the left lobe lobe provides a unique geometric profile against the ocean background.
